events.sql: SELECT p.attempt,p.lease_owner,p.lease_until AS parent_lease_until,q.attempts AS queue_attempt,q.lease_owner AS queue_owner,q.lease_until AS queue_lease_until,o.attempts AS outer_attempt,o.lease_owner AS outer_owner,o.lease_until AS outer_lease_until,b.expires_at AS prepared_expires_at,clock_timestamp() AS observed_at,GREATEST(p.lease_until,q.lease_until,o.lease_until) AS max_lease_until FROM operational_executions p JOIN operational_execution_outbox q ON q.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND q.execution_id=p.id JOIN controlled_published_bindings b ON b.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND b.execution_id=p.id JOIN outbox_events o ON o.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND o.id=b.outbox_id WHERE p.tenant_id=$1 AND p.id=$2
